svg.text: What it connects to, how it can be deployed, and what it holds — the three questions a capability diagram cannot answer
None of these are built today. The product ingests pasted transcripts only.
three shapes, one set of interfaces
what is held, and for how long
Highest risk, least value once transcribed
Right-to-delete is honoured across the database, the lake, the vector store and
object storage. Retention is configurable per class and enforced by a scheduled job.
None of it is implemented in this build — the POC keeps everything, in one SQLite file.
